title: Waterfall at the Gate, Tears on the Tarmac
excerpt: One last morning in the Botanic Gardens, then Changi's indoor waterfall nearly made me miss my flight home — and I cried watching the control tower disappear.

photos.alt: Expansive green lawn bordered by tropical trees and flowering shrubs under a dramatic blue sky with billowing white clouds, Singapore Botanic Gardens
The Rain Vortex, a massive indoor waterfall cascading from a circular rain oculus, surrounded by lush greenery under Jewel Changi Airport's glass-and-steel dome
Customers queuing at a 'Roasted Delights' chicken rice stall inside a NUS campus canteen, menu boards lit above the open kitchen
Changi Airport's iconic white control tower with its gold sphere, seen through a plane window as the aircraft taxis on the runway
